item.description:
## Search all projects got a lot better
Results now open by default, and you can fold any package, "Custom Scripts" group, or whole project section by clicking its header. Matched text is highlighted, and multi-word queries work: "web dev" finds `dev` in `web`.
## Global scripts settings
Refresh reloads your global scripts from disk, so edits made outside Grove show up without a relaunch. "New Global Script…" and "Connect Project Folder…" now sit at the top of their tabs, and the Settings window is bigger.

## The menu bar icon shows status at a glance
A green dot appears on the icon when a script is running, and a red alert badge when one has crashed. No need to open the popover to check.

## Share a running script over a public URL
Click Share next to Stop and Restart on any script with a detected port, and Grove opens a Cloudflare quick tunnel to it: a public HTTPS URL, live until you stop sharing. `cloudflared` isn't bundled; Grove looks for it on PATH and offers to install it with Homebrew the first time you use this.
## Agents can watch a tunnel come up
`grove logs <ref> --tunnel` (and `grove_get_logs` with `tunnel: true`) reads cloudflared's own connection output instead of the script's — the same cursor, `--follow`, and `--grep` support as regular logs.
